hints.title: Greedy Item Preference
hints.text: To maximize the sum, prioritize choosing 1s first, then 0s, and finally -1s only when necessary.

hints.title: Positive Intake
hints.text: Take min(k, numOnes) items of value 1, reducing k by that amount.

hints.title: Neutral and Negative Intake
hints.text: Consume as many zeros as possible up to min(k, numZeros). Any remaining k must come from -1 items.

hints.title: Greedy Value Intake Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def kItemsWithMaximumSum(self, numOnes: int, numZeros: int, numNegOnes: int, k: int) -> int:
        take_ones = min(k, numOnes)
        k -= take_ones
        take_zeros = min(k, numZeros)
        k -= take_zeros
        take_negs = k
        return take_ones - take_negs
```

variables: k: number of items to pick
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating item-by-item selection in a loop takes O(k).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Direct algebraic formula prioritizing 1s then 0s then -1s.
